facts.fact: Timoteo 在 Tor Bella Monaca 的家里做梦，梦里某个东西在追杀他，他知道有个英雄能保护他。
facts.anchor: Curled up in a tattered blanket, little Timoteo—a boy more tangled hair than puppy fat—visits a world of forests and villages.

facts.fact: Giulia 因半边脸的胎记每夜哭；梦里她跳进温暖的海，美人鱼吻了她的脸，胎记消失。
facts.anchor: Then one brushes a kiss against her cheek. Giulia starts back, because she doesn’t want this splendid creature to taint her lips on the Mark.

facts.fact: Zivorad 睡在台伯河桥下的垃圾与老鼠堆里，梦里扑向满桌食物；一只戴手套的手落到他脸上，一个男人说不想伤害他（叙述者说他在撒谎）。
facts.anchor: Then a gloved hand emerges from the dark and alights on his cheek.

facts.fact: Wendy 二十五岁，在主显节前夜的纳沃纳广场摊位变戏法，自觉已经太老、奇迹再也没有位置。
facts.anchor: While the children sleep, the Wondrous Wendy is obliged to put on a smile. She is twenty-five, and already feels too old.

facts.fact: Wendy 从粉衣男的耳后变出红围巾，并告诉他再做一次魔法就失效，套件十五欧元。
facts.anchor: “If you do it again, the magic wears out,” answers Wendy. “But for fifteen euros the kit is yours.”

facts.fact: PsyKlops 与 Wedge（真名 Giulio 与 Luca，分别是建筑师与罗马顶级商务顾问之子）去 San Basilio 涂鸦，被一群孩子围住。
facts.anchor: And now PsyKlops and Wedge—or rather Giulio and Luca, sons respectively of an architect and one of Rome’s leading business consultants—are scared.

facts.fact: 事后 Giulio 被杀死剥皮、Luca 背被打断、一只耳被撕掉；一个赤脚、比孩子们略高的身影对他耳语「告诉他们他要回来了」。
facts.anchor: Later, when Giulio is dead and skinned, and Luca’s back is broken and one of his ears ripped off, a graceful figure comes close.

numbers.value: 观众十人（含两位听不懂日语的老夫妇）
numbers.anchor: The audience (ten in total, including two elderly Japanese tourists who don’t understand a word) applaud.
She is twenty-five, and already feels too old.
But for fifteen euros the kit is yours.
It’s a tiny boy who can’t be more than five years old, with brown skin and tightly curled hair.

numbers.value: 十二月起就摆摊；主显节前夜
numbers.anchor: The piazza has been full of stalls since early December. Tonight is the Eve of the Epiphany
Wedge doesn’t want to, not here, and after all it’s only another hundred metres.

relations.note: Giulio（PsyKlops）是建筑师之子，Luca（Wedge）是商务顾问之子——涂鸦二人组的家世。
relations.anchor: And now PsyKlops and Wedge—or rather Giulio and Luca, sons respectively of an architect and one of Rome’s leading business consultants—are scared.

relations.note: 那群孩子听命于一个「他要回来了」的存在，并以伤害两个少年执行它。
relations.anchor: “Tell them he’s coming back,” they whisper.

relations.note: Wendy 是变戏法的艺人，不是被请来的贵宾：她在广场摆摊卖道具谋生。
relations.anchor: Sleight of hand for sale for everyone, art given away to people who can’t appreciate it.
